changes: Retain raw operational activity as audit; count only qualifying outcome types or positive revenue in both existing RPC commercial outcome counters
Exclude not_executed, execution_completed and no_response from attributed commercial touchpoints
Reuse existing two functions and exact scheduling, no duplicate database object or sender
prevention: Business KPI must derive from verified economic lifecycle rather than operational event row count
Maintain source lineage and actual response / order proof distinction
Re-run full-cycle proof and autonomous growth cycle after protected release and check 90-day count
required: Protected merge then production migration readback
Compare both RPC business counts to source-qualified count
No invented prospect replies, orders or realized revenue
